highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.4 resolves the HarfBuzz Windows binary configuration that triggered BinSkim BA2007.

bullets.detail: Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

harfbuzz_summary: Windows native assets now pass BinSkim BA2007 after scoping vendored-source warning suppression. Native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1; exports, shaping behavior, and unrelated existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

v4.151.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.4 removes the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.
